name: claude-mods
description: Claude Code mods (function-hook plugins) by youllook — small guards and panes that make Claude Code nicer on Windows and beyond

plugins.name: shell-guard
plugins.description: Windows shell guard: fixes backslash drive paths in Bash, blocks quote-eating node -e / heredoc patterns, and catches PowerShell/Bash syntax sent to the wrong shell

plugins.name: token-weather-cache
plugins.description: Context-window weather band above the prompt, plus a prompt-cache countdown with expiry toasts (modified from Anthropic's token-weather example)
